Working notes: claims CLM-7001–7010.

- Do not use channel, amount band, paper/phone/online, first claim, or missing photos as blanket decision rules. They caused errors:
  - Rejected but valid on appeal: 7002 (home/phone/large), 7003 (health/phone/large/first), 7005 (health/online/large), 7008 (auto/phone/large), 7009 (home/paper/large).
  - Approved but fraudulent: 7001 (auto/online/small, docs attached).
- Some red-flag rejections were correct: 7006 and 7007 were rejected with no/pending evidence; audit confirmed fraud. But 7009 also had photos pending and was valid. Missing evidence alone is not enough to reject; it supports investigation.
- Approvals that settled: 7004 (health/phone/small), 7010 (health/phone/large). A large health phone claim was valid, so large+phone is not a valid fraud signal.
- Use substantive evidence: verify event, coverage, amount, attachments, call notes, photos, and history. Look for concrete inconsistency or misrepresentation before rejecting.
- If evidence is missing, request specific substantiation; do not decide on band/channel alone.
- No channel/category/amount is dispositive. Auto, home, and health all include valid and fraudulent outcomes.
- Recommended rule: approve only after coverage and loss are substantiated; reject only with specific evidence of fraud/exclusion; otherwise investigate/request information.

Working notes: CLM-7001–7020.

- Blanket rules on channel, amount band, paper/phone/online, first claim, or missing photos remain invalid. Valid outcomes include 7002/3/5/8/9, 7004/10/12/13/14.
- Fraudulent approvals include 7001 and 7011, 7015–7020. Recent fraud cluster: health/home, online, small band (7011, 7015–7020). Treat this as a risk pattern, not a rejection rule.
- Missing photos alone is not enough: 7009 was valid with photos pending; 7017 was fraudulent with photos pending. Missing evidence means investigate/request substantiation—not auto-reject or auto-approve.
- Do not approve merely because no inconsistency is noted, premiums are current, claimant is reachable, amount is plausible, or it is a first claim. Fraudulent approvals used these thin justifications (7015, 7018, 7019).
- Settled approvals had substantive alignment: 7012 health/phone/small; 7013 auto/paper/large; 7014 home/phone/large.
- Before approval, verify event, coverage, loss/amount, attachments, treatment/invoice/receipts, call notes, photos, and claim history. For online small health/home with thin evidence, request specific substantiation.
- Reject only with concrete evidence of fraud, exclusion, or misrepresentation. Otherwise investigate/request information. No category, channel, or amount is dispositive.

Working notes: CLM-7001–7030.

- No blanket rule by channel, amount, category, first claim, or missing photos. Valid: 7002/3/5/8/9, 7004/10/12/13/14, 7021, 7024, 7027–7030.
- Fraudulent: 7001, 7011, 7015–7020, 7022, 7023, 7025, 7026. Persistent risk pattern: health/home, online, small band. It can include first claims and attached documents. 7025 shows “no red flag/exclusion” is not enough.
- Missing photos alone is not dispositive: 7009, 7017, 7024, 7026, 7028, 7030. It requires investigation/substantiation, not auto-approve or auto-reject. Phone/paper auto/home/health claims often settled even with photos pending (7028–7030).
- Thin justifications are insufficient: reachable, premiums current, first claim, amount plausible, no inconsistency noted, documents attached/scanned. These appeared in fraudulent approvals (7015, 7018, 7019, 7025).
- Before approval, verify event, coverage, loss/amount, attachments, invoices/receipts, call notes, photos, and claim history. For health/home online small claims, require specific substantiation; 7022/23/26 were correctly rejected, 7025 was fraudulent despite approval.
- Reject only with concrete evidence of fraud, exclusion, or misrepresentation; otherwise investigate/request information. No category, channel, or amount is dispositive alone.

Working notes: CLM-7001–7040.

- No blanket rule by channel, amount, category, first claim, photos, or reachability. Valid/approved: 7002/3/5/8/9, 7004/10/12/13/14, 7021, 7024, 7027–7032, 7035, 7036, 7038. Also valid on appeal despite rejection: 7033, 7040. Fraudulent: 7001, 7011, 7015–7020, 7022, 7023, 7025, 7026, 7034, 7037, 7039.
- Missing photos alone is not dispositive; 7031 health/phone/large approved with photos pending. Need investigation/substantiation, not auto-approve or auto-reject.
- Thin justifications insufficient: reachable, premiums current, first claim, amount plausible, no inconsistency, documents attached/scanned, call notes filed. These appeared in fraudulent approvals (7015, 7018, 7019, 7025) and confirmed frauds (7037, 7039). First claim alone (7039) insufficient.
- Phone/paper auto/home/health often settled even with photos pending (7028–7032, 7035, 7036, 7038). Auto paper/large can be valid (7036).
- Before approval verify event, coverage, loss/amount, attachments, invoices/receipts, call notes, photos, history. Health/online/small with insufficient substantiation: 7022/23/26/37 correctly rejected; 7025 fraudulent despite approval.
- Reject only with concrete evidence of fraud, exclusion, or misrepresentation. Reachability/large variation/paper health (7033) and home/phone/small missing event-coverage-damage (7040) were invalid rejections—investigate/request info instead. Online auto/small (7034) and home online/small first claim (7039) confirmed fraudulent; substantiation requirement supported.

Working notes: CLM-7001–7050.

- No blanket rule by channel, amount, category, first claim, photos, reachability, premiums, or attached documents. Valid/approved: 7002–5, 7008–10, 7012–14, 7021, 7024, 7027–7032, 7035–36, 7038, 7043, 7049–50. Valid on appeal after wrongful rejection: 7033, 7040, 7041, 7042, 7046, 7047. Fraudulent: 7001, 7011, 7015–20, 7022–23, 7025–26, 7034, 7037, 7039, 7044, 7045, 7048.
- Missing photos alone not dispositive: 7031 and 7050 (home online small) approved with photos pending. Auto phone/large with documents attached can be valid: 7041 (appeal), 7043; high amount alone not enough to reject.
- Thin justifications insufficient for approval: reachable, premiums current, first claim, amount plausible, no inconsistency, documents scanned/attached, call notes. Fraudulent approvals/confirmed frauds include 7015, 7018–19, 7025, 7037, 7039, 7044, 7045, 7048.
- Online auto/small is not inherently fraudulent or unsubstantiated: 7042, 7047 were valid on appeal. Do not reject for online auto/small alone.
- Health online/large needs substantiation of event, coverage, injury/treatment, and loss. Reachable alone (7044) or documents attached alone (7048) was fraudulent. Health online/small with premiums current was valid on appeal (7046); premiums current alone neither approves nor supports rejection.
- Home: online/large with only scanned documents was fraudulent (7045); paper/large with documents can be valid (7049); online/small with photos pending approved (7050).
- Before approval verify event, coverage, loss/amount, attachments, invoices/receipts, call notes, photos, history. Reject only with concrete evidence of fraud, exclusion, or misrepresentation; otherwise investigate/request info. Invalid rejections: 7033, 7040, 7041, 7042, 7046, 7047.

Working notes: CLM-7001–7060.

- No blanket approve/reject by channel, amount, category, first claim, photos, reachability, premiums, or attached documents. Decision needs claim-specific verification.
- Valid/approved: 7002–5, 7008–10, 7012–14, 7021, 7024, 7027–32, 7035–36, 7038, 7043, 7049–54. Valid on appeal after wrongful rejection: 7033, 7040, 7041, 7042, 7046, 7047, 7059, 7060.
- Confirmed fraudulent: 7001, 7011, 7015–20, 7022–23, 7025–26, 7034, 7037, 7039, 7044, 7045, 7048, 7055–58.
- Thin justifications (reachable, premiums current, first claim, amount plausible, no inconsistency, documents scanned/attached, call notes) are insufficient for approval.
- High-risk pattern: online home/large and online health/large claims are often fraudulent when substantiation is thin (7055–58). Call notes, premiums current, or photos pending alone do not cure missing evidence of event, coverage, treatment/damage, and loss.
- But channel/amount alone is never enough: home phone/large with photos pending was valid on appeal (7059); auto phone/large with premiums current was valid on appeal (7060). Do not reject solely for missing photos/documents; request them.
- Health paper/small with premiums current approved (7053). Auto online/small with photos pending approved (7054). Home paper/large reachable approved (7051); home phone/small reachable approved (7052).
- Before approval verify event, coverage, loss/amount, invoices/receipts, documents/photos, call notes, history. Reject only with concrete fraud/exclusion/misrepresentation evidence; otherwise investigate/request info.

Working notes: CLM-7001–7070.

- No blanket approve/reject by channel, amount, category, first claim, photos, reachability, premiums, attached documents, or call notes. Decisions need claim-specific verification.
- Valid/approved: 7002–5, 7008–10, 7012–14, 7021, 7024, 7027–32, 7035–36, 7038, 7043, 7049–54, 7063, 7064, 7068. Valid on appeal after wrongful rejection: 7033, 7040–42, 7046–47, 7059–60, 7065–66.
- Confirmed fraudulent: 7001, 7011, 7015–20, 7022–23, 7025–26, 7034, 7037, 7039, 7044–45, 7048, 7055–58, 7061–62, 7067, 7069–70.
- Thin justifications are not enough for approval by themselves: reachable, premiums current, first claim, amount plausible, no inconsistency, documents scanned/attached, call notes, photos pending.
- High-risk: online home/large and online health/large with thin substantiation often fraudulent (7055–58). But do not reject solely for online/large or missing photos/docs: health online/large with documents attached was valid on appeal (7065); auto online/large with call notes was valid on appeal (7066); health paper/large with photos pending settled (7064, 7068). Request missing documents.
- Home phone/large is risky when supported only by call notes, premiums current, or first claim (7061–62, 7067, 7069–70 fraudulent). Yet home phone/large with photos pending was valid on appeal (7059).
- Other valid examples: auto paper/large reachable (7063); auto phone/large premiums current on appeal (7060); home paper/large reachable (7051); home phone/small reachable (7052); health paper/small premiums current (7053); auto online/small photos pending (7054).
- Before approval verify event, coverage, loss/amount, invoices/receipts, documents/photos, call notes, history. Reject only with concrete fraud/exclusion/misrepresentation evidence; otherwise investigate/request info.
